sourceChecks.text: The people who were encamped heard that Zimri had conspired, and had also killed the king. Therefore all Israel made Omri, the captain of the army, king over Israel that day in the camp.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEB本文の明示名と前後文脈を確認。

sourceChecks.text: Omri went up from Gibbethon, and all Israel with him, and they besieged Tirzah.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEB本文の明示名と前後文脈を確認。

sourceChecks.text: Then the people of Israel were divided into two parts: half of the people followed Tibni the son of Ginath, to make him king, and half followed Omri.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEB本文の明示名と前後文脈を確認。

sourceChecks.text: But the people who followed Omri prevailed against the people who followed Tibni the son of Ginath; so Tibni died, and Omri reigned.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEB本文の明示名と前後文脈を確認。

sourceChecks.text: In the thirty-first year of Asa king of Judah, Omri began to reign over Israel for twelve years. He reigned six years in Tirzah.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEB本文の明示名と前後文脈を確認。

sourceChecks.text: Omri did that which was evil in the LORD’s sight, and dealt wickedly above all who were before him.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEB本文の明示名と前後文脈を確認。

sourceChecks.text: Now the rest of the acts of Omri which he did, and his might that he showed, aren’t they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEB本文の明示名と前後文脈を確認。

sourceChecks.text: So Omri slept with his fathers, and was buried in Samaria; and Ahab his son reigned in his place.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEB本文の明示名と前後文脈を確認。

sourceChecks.text: In the thirty-eighth year of Asa king of Judah, Ahab the son of Omri began to reign over Israel. Ahab the son of Omri reigned over Israel in Samaria twenty-two years.
